test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - GK/CA (Held on: 15 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following Articles provides the minorities the right to establish and administer educational institutions of their choice?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 30**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Article 30** of the Indian Constitution grants minorities the right to establish and administer educational institutions of their choice.
 
• This article is part of the Fundamental Rights guaranteed under Part III of the Indian Constitution.
 
• The term "minorities" in Article 30 primarily refers to religious and linguistic minorities.
 
• The article ensures that minorities can preserve and promote their culture and language through their educational institutions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 29**

 
 
• Article 29 of the Indian Constitution provides that any section of the citizens residing in the territory of India or any part thereof having a distinct language, script, or culture of its own shall have the right to conserve the same.
 
• This article protects the interests of minorities by ensuring that their language, script, or culture is not discriminated against.
 
 
 
• **Article 28**
 
 
• Article 28 deals with the freedom as to attendance at religious instruction or religious worship in certain educational institutions.
 
• No religious instruction shall be provided in any educational institution wholly maintained out of State funds.
 
 
 
• **Article 31**
 
 
• Article 31 originally dealt with the right to property but was repealed by the 44th Amendment Act of 1978.
 
• After its repeal, the right to property is no longer a fundamental right but a constitutional right under Article 300A.
